**error-log-analyzer v1.1.0 Changelog**

- Added new feedback and testing modules (including AI accuracy and test case files).
- Improved codebase organization by introducing the src/feedback/ directory.
- Introduced automated testing scripts (run_tests.py, test.sh).
- Removed obsolete demo, report, and test files for a cleaner structure.
- Updated core package initialization and project documentation.
Cleaned up repository: removed temporary documentation files, keeping only core skill files
Updated GitHub repository links to janseling/error-log-analyzer
Updated author to janseling and install command to janseling/error-log-analyzer

Initial release of error-log-analyzer.

- Analyze error logs from Node.js, Python, and Go, with auto-detection of log format.
- Explains errors in plain English and provides actionable fix suggestions with code examples.
- Groups and filters recurring/duplicate errors, focusing on critical issues.
- Tracks error patterns and trends over time.
- Supports real-time log monitoring and custom filtering.
- Offers both API and CLI usage, with configuration via environment variables and YAML file.
- Free trial available; paid plans for higher volume and advanced features.
